words: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs?
Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God?
do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
who are you to judge your neighbor?
